answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a reputation kernel: every agent locks a refundable stake before trading, and the kernel scores agents from their real transaction history, so a fresh identity starts at zero trust and must earn standing slowly. A rotating beacon broadcasts unpredictable audit tasks that only agents with genuine history can answer in time, so a flood of fake identities cannot pass. Each verified agent also carries a tamper-evident credential, like a jade seal, that cannot be duplicated cheaply. An attacker must pay real stake and real time for every fake identity.
